title: Global derived Hom adjunction for derived pullback and direct image
statement: Let g:T\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback Lg^*:D(\mathcal O_S)\to D(\mathcal O_T) [def-pc-derived-pullback] and derived direct image Rg_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on the derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category]. Regard R\operatorname{Hom}_T(-,-)\in D(\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)) [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] as an object of D(\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)) by restriction of scalars along g^\sharp:\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)\to\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T). For M\in D(\mathcal O_S) and E\in D(\mathcal O_T) there is an isomorphism of global derived Hom complexes $$R\operatorname{Hom}_S(M,Rg_*E)\cong R\operatorname{Hom}_T(Lg^*M,E)$$ [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] in D(\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)), natural in M and E, which on H^0 is the adjunction bijection \operatorname{Hom}(M,Rg_*E)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*M,E),\ \varphi\mapsto\varepsilon_E\circ Lg^*\varphi [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general] and which is the composite of the map R\operatorname{Hom}_S(M,Rg_*E)\to R\operatorname{Hom}_T(Lg^*M,Lg^*Rg_*E) induced by derived pullback with postcomposition by the counit \varepsilon_E:Lg^*Rg_*E\to E.
